caption: The drawing depicts two distinct gray architectural elements set against a plain beige background. In the upper left corner, there is a thick, ornate bracket or support piece with a highly stylized, curvilinear silhouette, casting subtle gray shadows. This element extends diagonally from the left and top edges toward the center. In the lower right quadrant, there is a simpler geometric shape composed of a vertical rectangular column with a semicircular cap and an adjacent stepped or jagged form extending horizontally to the left, also rendered in shades of gray. Thin gray lines form a right-angled border along the top and left edges of the composition. The overall arrangement leaves large areas of the beige background exposed, creating a balanced distribution of the elements on the page.
title: Half-canopy Carved Bed
